faq1Q.message: How do I start using the Steamlvlup Card Factory extension?

faq1A.message: You need to be registered on the Steamlvlup.com website (just authorize on the site through your Steam account, using OAuth from Steam, this is the official way from Steam that allows us to understand that you are the owner of this account, after authorization we will receive from you only PUBLIC INFORMATION, you cannot lose access to your account or lose items from your inventory, it's COMPLETELY SAFE). Then just click on the 'Start Drops' button, our extension will do the rest for you. Also, as the cards fall out, you will receive sound notifications about the receipt of cards or the end of the drop process (if this option is enabled)

faq2Q.message: How does the Steamlvlup Card Factory extension work?

faq2A.message: We send information to Steam that you are playing a game, you don't even need to install it, the games change automatically, after a certain time you will receive cards from those games that you launched through our extension.

faq3Q.message: Can my friends see what I'm playing when I use your extension?

faq3A.message: According to the standard settings, while drop out cards, you go into the 'Invisible' mode so that your friends do not see how you change games and re-enter them. You can also remove this feature in the settings on the page if you want

faq4Q.message: What algorithm do you use to drop out cards?

faq4A.message: We run several games at the same time, you can choose the number yourself, but no more than 32 at the same time. After a certain time, you get a card and we change this game to another one (if this feature is enabled), since Steam has a limit on receiving cards, approximately 1 hour from one game.

faq5Q.message: Why I can't play games on Steam during a card draw?

faq5A.message: You can run games on Steam, but only games that don't use an internet connection. If the game uses the internet, then this may lead to a loss of connection to Steam on the card drop page. If you are already playing a game on Steam that is using an internet connection and you decide to start a card drop, this may result in you being disconnected from that game. Just turn off drop out cards and try reconnecting to the game.

faq6Q.message: What can I do with the cards after receiving them?

faq6A.message: After receiving the cards, you will not have enough of them to create a badge for this game. You can buy the remaining cards on the Marketplace and create a badge for this game. You can also deposit these cards on the Steamlvlup.com website and buy full sets of cards for them, from which you can immediately create badges.

faq7Q.message: Why have I not received at least one card since the start of drop out cards?

faq7A.message: Cards cannot drop on accounts with limited rights, regardless of the games they have. Previously it was possible, but now it is not. To remove the account restriction, top up your Steam Wallet or spend the equivalent of $5 in the store. It is not possible to receive cards from paid games that you received for free during the promotion, regardless of what is indicated on the store page. Previously it was possible, but now it is not. Cards do not drop from Free2Play free games if you have not spent money in this game. This means that F2P games such as Team Fortress 2 or Dota 2. Owning F2P games does not entitle you to receive cards.

faq8Q.message: How long do I have to wait for the cards to drop?

faq8A.message: Each game has its own farming difficulty set by the developer/publisher, and only they decide how fast the cards will drop. In most games, about 1 card falls out in 30 minutes of play, but there are games that need to be played for several hours before at least one card falls out. In addition, your account may have a card drop limit for games you've played for less than a certain amount of time.

faq9Q.message: How are you different from Idle Master, SAM or other similar programs?

faq9A.message: The main difference is that we do not require you to pass a username, password or cookies before use. Our extension uses a custom algorithm for knocking out cards, which we tested ourselves and configured it to knock out cards most efficiently and quickly, in further updates we will also update and improve it. Also, you do not need to install third-party software on your computer or other device.

faq10Q.message: What information can we receive and store from the user?

faq10A.message: We do not share or store your personal account and user information. We, unlike other card drop programs, do not require you to enter your personal data from your account (login and password) to ensure the operation of the program. All that we can learn about you is only public information or what was obtained by authorizing on our website Steamlvlup.com through OAuth Steam.

faq11Q.message: Can I get a VAC ban for using the Steamlvlup Card Factory extension?

faq11A.message: No, this is not possible, because our extension (unlike IdleMaster and SAM) does not interact with the Steam client and its processes in any way. It's physically impossible to get VAC, even while using secure servers - simply because the extension doesn't even need the Steam client to be installed to work properly.

faq12Q.message: Can I get banned for this?

faq12A.message: Like any Steam software, the Steamlvlup Card Factory extension is not approved by Valve, and we cannot guarantee that you will not be banned if Valve suddenly decides to ban the account from which you used our extension. This is extremely unlikely, but still possible, regardless of the actual likelihood. However, Valve explicitly acknowledges the existence of 'Steam idlers', so if you ask us, we're pretty sure that if they were against this kind of software, they would do something about it. You use this extension at your own risk. The chances that you will be banned are very small, but if you do, you can only blame yourself.

faq0Q.message: Why don't I see some games in the list?

faq0A.message: If you received the game for free or did not spend a certain amount of money in the game, you cannot receive cards from this game.
